trailer.createmotorsport.no_endpoint: No other assembled hitch found nearby. Assemble both vehicles separately.
trailer.createmotorsport.capture_gap: Hitch outside capture area: %s blocks. Glowing particles mark the coupling centres.
trailer.createmotorsport.permission: You do not own this equipment
trailer.createmotorsport.unsupported: Landing legs must support the trailer
trailer.createmotorsport.select_equipmen: Panel selected. Use the linker on a hitch or landing legs.
tune.createmotorsport.engine.engine_iner: Rotating inertia of the engine + flywheel (kg*m^2)
tune.createmotorsport.engine.traction_co: Should be kept right under the tire compound's longitudinal slip at peak
Throttle applied at minimum by traction control
tune.createmotorsport.gearbox.semi_auto: false = full manual: you must hold the clutch channel to change gear. true = paddle shifting
tune.createmotorsport.gearbox.clutch.max: Maximum torque (Nm) a fully-engaged clutch can transmit before it starts to slip. If it was below the engine peak crank torque, clutch would always slip. It scales with the engine's design mass, as the engine's torque does.
tune.createmotorsport.gearbox.clutch.loc: How hard the clutch pulls the engine speed to the gearbox speed once it is engaged and no longer slipping (Nm per rad/s of speed mismatch).
tune.createmotorsport.gearbox.clutch.lau: The RPM which the auto-clutch holds the engine at during a standing start, like an F1 launch based on F1 launch controls.
tune.createmotorsport.gearbox.center_dif: AWD only; the center differential's front torque share. 0.5 = even split; lower is rear biased, so more oversteer
AWD only; 0 = open center diff. 0.5 = up to half the torque can be transferred. 1.0 = locked center
tune.createmotorsport.setup.ackermann: 0 = both front wheels turn the same angle (parallel). Positive = anti-ackermann, so the outer wheel in a corner turns sharper than the inner; negative = classic Ackermann, so the inner wheel turns sharper. 1.0 is the full amount for this car's track width and wheelbase.
tune.createmotorsport.setup.camber_deg: Negative angle leans the top of the tyre in
tune.createmotorsport.setup.camber_stiff: Multiple for the slip physics effects of camber
tune.createmotorsport.setup.steer_full_l: Steering assist wont affect steering angle under this speed
tune.createmotorsport.setup.roll_influen: Where the lateral tire force is applied vertically; 0 is at centre of mass (least rollover potential), 1 is ground level (most roll potential).
tune.createmotorsport.setup.brakes.stren: Peak braking force per wheel at full brake, before grip limits it. It scales with the car's measured mass, and the torque is this times the tire's radius. Braking needs to be improved overall, so this will be updated later
tune.createmotorsport.setup.brakes.abs_s: ABS only; braking slip ratio where the ABS starts releasing brake pressure. Peak grip on the slip curve sits around 0.1-0.2, so keep it near here, but if you want to change it, higher = allows more slip
tune.createmotorsport.setup.brakes.abs_m: ABS shuts off under this speed (in-world blocks per second) so the car can stop
tune.createmotorsport.differential.drift: When you toggle diff mode on, an alternate differential setting is chosen.
tune.createmotorsport.compound.grip: Friction coefficient of the tire compound. Over/understeering balance can be adjusted by making the front and rear have different grip
tune.createmotorsport.compound.rolling_r: Rolling resistance as a fraction of the tire's vertical load
tune.createmotorsport.compound.thermal.o: Thermal model only; optimal tire temperature in Celsius for grip
tune.createmotorsport.compound.thermal.c: Thermal model only; grip fraction when the tire is ambient temp. 0.6 = 60% grip when cold
tune.createmotorsport.compound.thermal.h: Thermal model only; how fast the slip energy heats the tire (deg C per joule of friction work). Higher = tires warm up faster; needs tuning to our force scale
tune.createmotorsport.compound.thermal.c: Thermal model only; how fast the tire cools toward ambient (per second, scaled up with speed for airflow). Higher = harder to keep warm (cools faster).
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.lo: TMeasy tire model only; grip once the tire is fully sliding, as a fraction of its peak. Rill's data suggested as high as ~0.97 is still realistic, which was surprising to me. This will also be a mechanism for difficulty.
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.la: TMeasy tire model only; grip once the tire is fully sliding, as a fraction of its peak. Rill's data suggested as high as ~0.97 is still realistic, which was surprising to me. This will also be a mechanism for difficulty.
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.lo: TMeasy tire model only; longitudinal slip ratio at which grip peaks (drive/brake). Lower = peak grip at less wheelspin, but has a sharper drop from peak.
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.la: TMeasy tire model only; lateral slip (~tan of slip angle) at which cornering grip peaks, Lower = sharper turn-in but breaks away at a smaller slip angle.
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.lo: TMeasy tire model only; how far past the peak slip the tire reaches full slide, as a multiple of the peak slip, so 4.0 = grip fades from peak to sliding over 4x the peak slip
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.la: TMeasy tire model only; how far past the peak slip the tire reaches full slide, as a multiple of the peak slip, so 4.0 = grip fades from peak to sliding over 4x the peak slip
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.lo: TMeasy tire model only; how sharply grip builds up from zero slip as a multiple of minimum consistent slope (peakForce / slipAtPeak). 2.0 is TMeasy's soft-tyre floor; Rill's examples were about 3x
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.la: TMeasy tire model only; how sharply grip builds up from zero slip as a multiple of minimum consistent slope (peakForce / slipAtPeak). 2.0 is TMeasy's soft-tyre floor; Rill's examples were about 3x
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.re: Tire relaxation length (in-world blocks) which is the distance the tire must roll for its side force to build up, instead of responding instantly. Car wobbles if this is too low
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.br: TMeasy tire model only; damping of the Dahl stand-still bristle spring, as a fraction of critical damping, Lower makes the car sway at a stop; Raise past 1 to over-damp
tune.createmotorsport.compound.tmeasy.st: TMeasy tire model only; velocity (in-world blocks per second) that makes the Dahl bristle's held side force leak away. Held force fades over about relax length lat / this seconds. HIGHER = less creep, but softer grip at very low speed.
TMeasy tire model only; speed (in-world blocks per second) below which the lateral force comes from Rill's Dahl bristle stand-still model. Uses relax length lat as the bristle's build-up distance
tune.createmotorsport.compound.fiala.sli: Fiala tire model only; Fiala longitudinal slip stiffness (N per unit slip ratio). Higher = grip peak at a lower slip %. This is calibrated from a specific tire I found in Project Chrono, where 193929 N is scaled down to a 65kpg car. Will handle scale better later
tune.createmotorsport.compound.fiala.cor: Fiala tire model only; Fiala cornering stiffness (N per radian of slip angle). Higher breaks away more suddenly. Calibrated from a Chrono example to ~65kpg again
tune.createmotorsport.compound.fiala.mu_: Fiala tire model only; peak friction, as a multiple of the compound's grip (1.0 = exactly its grip). Scales by surface friction and load sensitivity
Fiala tire model only; Fiala sliding friction, as a multiple of the compound's grip
tune.createmotorsport.compound.fiala.rel: Fiala tire model only; tire relaxation length (in-world blocks) which is the distance the tire must roll for its slip force to build up, instead of responding instantly. Car wobbles if this is too low
tune.createmotorsport.compound.pacejka.c: Pacejka B/C/E done the same as Speed dreams for now: C = 2 - asin(RFactor)*2/PI, B = Ca/C, E = EFactor
tune.createmotorsport.compound.pacejka.r: Pacejka B/C/E done the same as Speed dreams for now: C = 2 - asin(RFactor)*2/PI, B = Ca/C, E = EFactor
tune.createmotorsport.compound.pacejka.e: Pacejka B/C/E done the same as Speed dreams for now: C = 2 - asin(RFactor)*2/PI, B = Ca/C, E = EFactor
